messages:
maya: FYI opened a small docs hotfix PR after the outage — adds statuspage links, known-issues note and a temporary SDK snippet workaround. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 :eyes:

samir: Thanks. Can you paste the failing preview link? I tried the CI preview and it 404'd.

maya: docs-bot posted the preview but it points to the wrong path. preview: https://deploy-preview-5123--docs.redwood.ai/status (404)

lee: I can take the preview CI failure. quick guess: relative link broke because we moved /status under /platform.

andre: If it's just a link path we should fix and merge quickly. Who's the reviewer? We need one more before merge.

maya: Requested review from @lee and @carla. Leaving a note for backport to release branch `v0.12` after merge. Also adding a short workaround SDK snippet for customers hit by the KV-cache inconsistency (temporary patch to force fresh session).

carla: Quick look now. Also: we should add timestamped note pointing to the incident postmortem once it's live.

lee: Found the link bug — in docs/status/index.md we used `../status` but the new site root is `/platform/status`. Changing to an absolute path fixes preview.

maya: Patch in PR: changed link and added known-issues block. Also added SDK snippet under "Temporary workarounds".

samir: Can you paste the SDK snippet here so I can sanity check?

maya: Sure — it's just a short client-side forcing of a new session token for affected SDKs.

maya: ```python
# temporary workaround: force new session to avoid stale KV state
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=REDACTED)
client.reset_session(session_id=None)  # creates fresh session and KV cache
response = client.generate("Hello")
print(response.text)
```

andre: That looks fine as a temporary snippet. Add a warning banner: "Temporary workaround — remove after incident is resolved."

carla: Review done, left one tiny nit on wording in the known-issues paragraph.

maya: nit fixed and pushed. CI docs preview retriggered. docs-bot: can you post new preview link?

docs-bot: New deploy preview available: https://deploy-preview-5123--docs.redwood.ai/ (status page resolves) :white_check_mark:

samir: Preview looks good to me — link works, SDK snippet renders and is fenced properly.

lee: I'll approve and merge once CI is green. Schedule: merging during the 11:30–12:00 PST merge window to avoid interfering with rolling deploys.

maya: Thanks all. After merge: backport to `v0.12` branch (andre), add changelog entry (maya), and update postmortem with docs link when postmortem is published.

andre: I'll handle backport right after merge and open the backport PR.

carla: Also adding a short teaser note in #customer-success so CS teams know there's a workaround doc.

maya: :thumbsup: done. Closing thread once backport PR is created.
